text:
```yaml
name: Update Requests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Weekly on Monday
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.1'
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Update Composer dependencies
        run: |
          composer update --no-interaction --no-scripts --no-suggest
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add composer.lock
          git diff --quiet && git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "chore: update composer dependencies"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          commit-message: "chore: update composer dependencies"
          title: "chore: update composer dependencies"
          body: |
            Automated update of composer dependencies.
            
            This PR was generated by the `update-requests` workflow.
          branch: "chore/update-dependencies"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            dependencies
            automated
```
